headline: This law directs the Capitol to obtain and permanently install statues honoring Supreme Court Justices Sandra Day O'Connor and Ruth Bader Ginsburg.
what_it_does: The law requires the Joint Committee on the Library to obtain a statue of Justice Sandra Day O'Connor and a statue of Justice Ruth Bader Ginsburg. It requires the Architect of the Capitol to permanently install both statues in the U.S. Capitol or on the Capitol Grounds. The summary does not describe the statues' design, cost, or exact location.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on April 13, 2022, and the summary does not give a separate deadline for installation.
